scope: Deduplicated aggregate of separate complete native runs on varying toolchains; not a whole-suite run or a measurement of the current compiler. Pass fraction is a current-evidence lower bound over the full pinned denominator.
precedence: Latest report generatedAt/timestamp/completedAt/startedAt, otherwise linked journal start time or first Git addition commit date, otherwise report first Git addition commit date. Equal dates: lexically greatest repository-relative filename wins. No filesystem mtimes. Missing dates reject evidence. Canonical reports and journals compete by this same rule; later failures replace earlier passes.

evidenceAge.note: Git addition dates are proxies where run timestamps are absent; unknown toolchains remain explicitly unknown.
